events.action: Displays opening title cards and cast credits.
events.description: The title card for The Greene Murder Case is displayed accompanied by background music. Additional credit cards follow, listing the director, story writer, and cast.

events.action: Walks through the snow towards the Greene mansion.
events.description: An elderly gentleman in a top hat and overcoat walks through the entrance gate on a snowy night. He approaches the front door of the mansion.

events.action: Ascend the main staircase inside the mansion.
events.description: Sproot the butler greets Mr. Cannon inside the entrance hall and leads him up the grand wooden staircase. They head toward the upper floor hallway.

events.action: Mr. Cannon knocks on Chester's room door.
events.description: Mr. Cannon knocks on Chester Greene's door to call him for the annual reading of the will. Inside, Chester expresses annoyance while sitting in his armchair drinking.

events.actor: Mr. Cannon, Mrs. Tobias Greene, and Chester Greene
events.action: Mr. Cannon enters Mrs. Greene's bedroom.
events.description: Mr. Cannon enters Mrs. Greene's bedroom where she lies in bed. Chester and other family members gather as Cannon prepares to review the terms of the estate.

events.action: Sibella enters and talks about her evening plans.
events.description: Sibella enters the bedroom wearing a dress and holding a cigarette. She announces her intention to go out to the theater with Dr. Von Blon.

events.action: Reads the provisions of Tobias Greene's will.
events.description: Mr. Cannon reviews the legal document, reminding the family that they must live in the mansion together for 15 years to receive their shares in 1934. He notes that if anyone dies, the share is split among the surviving members.

events.actor: Chester Greene, Mrs. Tobias Greene, and Mr. Cannon
events.action: Chester complains and Mrs. Greene laments her children.
events.description: Chester voices intense resentment about being trapped in the house for ten years. Mrs. Greene complains about her ungrateful children before Mr. Cannon wishes them good evening and leaves.

events.actor: Ada Greene, Gertrude Hemming, and Mrs. Mannheim
events.action: Ada collects broth in the kitchen.
events.description: Ada enters the kitchen where servant Gertrude speaks ominously about the cursed family doomed by God. Gertrude then hands Ada a bowl of warm broth for Mrs. Greene.

events.actor: Ada Greene and Mrs. Tobias Greene
events.action: Ada reads a novel to her mother.
events.description: Ada delivers the broth to Mrs. Greene in bed and takes a seat beside her. Mrs. Greene instructs Ada to continue reading aloud from the novel where they left off.

events.action: Sits alone in his room as midnight approaches.
events.description: Chester sits in his armchair in his darkened room holding a book and glass. A nearby tabletop clock ticks past 11:55 PM toward midnight.

events.actor: Unseen Shooter and Mrs. Tobias Greene
events.action: Gunshots break the quiet and Mrs. Greene panics.
events.description: Two sudden gunshots resonate through the dark, quiet mansion. Mrs. Greene wakes up screaming hysterically in her bed, calling out for her children.

events.actor: Mrs. Tobias Greene, Chester Greene, and Rex Greene
events.action: Rex and Chester rush in after the shooting.
events.description: Rex and Chester hurry into the room in response to the gunfire and screams. They report that Ada and Sibella have been shot, leaving Mrs. Greene in shock.

events.action: Discusses the Greene murder case on the phone
events.description: District Attorney Markham talks on the telephone in his office, confirming that Chester Greene was killed instantly while his sister was wounded. Sergeant Heath stands nearby as Markham discusses the initial burglary hypothesis.

events.action: Takes over the phone call with Philo Vance
events.description: Sergeant Heath takes the telephone receiver to speak directly with Philo Vance. Vance questions the burglary theory, highlighting how strange it is that a burglar would linger in the hall for three minutes between two shots.

events.action: Questions the butler at the Greene mansion
events.description: At the Greene residence, Philo Vance questions the butler regarding the sound of the gunshots. The butler confirms hearing two shots with approximately three minutes elapsing between them.

events.action: Analyzes Chester Greene's posture and facial expression
events.description: Vance discusses Chester Greene's fatal shooting with Sergeant Heath and Rex Greene. Vance notes that Chester was shot from the front at close range without making a sound, suggesting he was astonished to recognize his killer.

events.action: Questions Rex Greene about his handguns
events.description: Sergeant Heath asks if anyone in the household owns a gun. Rex Greene admits he owned a .32 caliber revolver but claims he searched for it after the crime and found it missing.

events.action: Accuses Dr. Von Blon of stealing his gun and seeking family money
events.description: An agitated Rex Greene points at Dr. Von Blon, shouting that the doctor stole his revolver to murder the family and secure the inheritance. Rex lunges toward Dr. Von Blon before being held back.

events.action: Talks to Sergeant Heath and Philo Vance
events.description: Dr. Von Blon speaks calmly with Sergeant Heath and Vance regarding his arrival time and when the investigators will be permitted to speak with the injured Ada Greene.

events.action: Expresses contempt for her family members
events.description: Sibella Greene enters and speaks nonchalantly to the investigators. She states that all family members hate each other and admits she has personally considered killing the entire household.

events.action: Confers quietly with Dr. Von Blon
events.description: Sibella Greene and Dr. Von Blon discuss delaying a personal agreement or relationship matter, agreeing that proceeding now would be inappropriate following the shooting.

events.action: Recounts the shooting from her bed
events.description: In her bedroom, Ada Greene describes waking up to a noise she thought was an engine backfiring, followed by a dark figure touching her hand and a shuffling noise before she was shot.

events.action: Confronts Ada Greene in her bedroom
events.description: Sibella enters Ada's bedroom and harshly accuses Ada of lying, calling her deceitful and suggesting she shot Chester herself. Dr. Von Blon intervenes to pull Sibella away.

events.action: Administers medication to Ada Greene from his medical bag
events.description: Dr. Von Blon opens his doctor's kit containing various vials and hypodermic needles. He prepares and gives Ada a sedative to help her rest.

events.action: Examines footprint impressions on the snowy exterior balustrade
events.description: Sergeant Heath, Vance, and a police officer inspect footprint casts in the snow on the outer balcony. The officers note that the intruder wore galoshes and that the tracks end abruptly at the wall.

events.action: Questions Dr. Von Blon about his medical kit and Mrs. Greene's condition
events.description: On the porch, Vance remarks on Dr. Von Blon's extensive supply of drugs in his medical bag and asks about Mrs. Greene's physical health. Dr. Von Blon replies that Mrs. Greene suffers from hopeless organic paralysis in both legs.

events.action: Demands that the police leave her house
events.description: Sergeant Heath and Philo Vance enter the bedroom of bedridden matriarch Mrs. Greene. Resting in her canopy bed alongside Rex, she angrily orders the officers to cease their investigation and get out of her home.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Rex Greene, and Mrs. Greene
events.action: Questioning Rex Greene in the bedroom
events.description: Philo Vance questions Rex Greene in front of Mrs. Greene regarding what he heard before the gunshots. Rex claims he only heard a door blowing in the hall prior to sleeping.

events.actor: Ada Greene, Nurse, and Mrs. Greene
events.action: Discussing room noises
events.description: Ada Greene mentions hearing a door noise similar to what Rex described while lying in bed attended by a nurse and another woman.

events.action: Examining galoshes
events.description: Detective Heath holds up a pair of galoshes and confronts Rex Greene, questioning whether they belong to him.

events.action: Arguing in the hallway
events.description: Rex angrily states he was not out of the house last night and demands to leave, but Heath insists he remain under surveillance.

events.actor: Philo Vance, District Attorney Markham, and Detective Heath
events.action: Discussing case theories in the office
events.description: In the District Attorney's office, Vance, Markham, and Heath debate whether the crime was committed by an outsider or someone familiar with the family.

events.actor: Ada Greene, Philo Vance, and District Attorney Markham
events.action: Arriving at the D.A.'s office
events.description: An assistant announces Ada Greene, who enters Markham's office to share information regarding recent events at the house.

events.actor: Ada Greene, Philo Vance, and District Attorney Markham
events.action: Reporting suspicious details
events.description: Ada informs Vance and Markham that she saw Rex moving galoshes and mentions a written paper containing medical terms spoken by Dr. Von Blon.

events.action: Calling Rex Greene over the telephone
events.description: Markham places a call to the Greene home, and Ada speaks to Rex over the line, asking him to fetch a note from their mailbox.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Ada Greene, and Rex Greene
events.action: Overhearing gunshot over phone line
events.description: A struggle and gunshot sound are heard over the phone line. Vance takes the receiver and pronounces Rex dead as Ada faints in her chair.

events.action: Rushing to the scene
events.description: Police officers and investigators drive rapidly to the Greene mansion following the emergency phone call.

events.actor: Philo Vance, District Attorney Markham, and Detective Heath
events.action: Discovering Rex Greene's body
events.description: Vance, Markham, and Heath enter the room and find Rex Greene lying dead on the carpeted floor.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Dr. Von Blon, and Detective Heath
events.action: Inspecting the victim's body
events.description: Vance notes that Rex was shot from the front and compares his expression to Chester's, while Dr. Von Blon claims he was elsewhere in the house and heard no shot.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Sproot, and Detective Heath
events.action: Searching for the note and checking phone lines
events.description: Vance discovers the note is missing from Rex's body. Heath asks Sproot to detail all telephone extensions present in the mansion.

events.actor: Medical Examiner, Philo Vance, and Detective Heath
events.action: Examining the corpse
events.description: The medical examiner arrives to evaluate Rex's body and locate the bullet for forensic analysis.

events.action: Interrogating Sibella in her room
events.description: Vance visits Sibella Greene in her room while she holds her small dog, questioning her regarding her whereabouts during the shooting.

events.action: Asks to speak privately on the roof
events.description: Ada tells her companion that she is frightened and wishes to speak alone on the roof garden. She goes to retrieve her coat while he agrees to meet her up there.

events.action: Demands her pay and quits her job
events.description: The house maid complains to the investigators about the bizarre behavior and tension among the Greene family members. She demands her pay from the butler and declares that she is quitting immediately.

events.action: Explains where he was during the gunshot
events.description: Philo Vance questions Sproot about why he did not previously report hearing the recent gunshot. Sproot states he was replacing silverware in the dining room after calling Rex to the phone, noting that Ada's room sits directly above the dining room.

events.action: Answers questions about her tenure with the family
events.description: Vance asks Mrs. Mannheim how long she has worked at the Greene residence. She replies that she has been there for thirteen years since her husband died, noting that old Tobias Greene knew her husband.

events.action: Expresses frustration and offers to locate Tobias Greene's will
events.description: Sergeant Heath remarks that if he could find the murder weapon, he would report the shootings as suicides and resign. Vance discusses historical newspaper reports regarding old Tobias Greene, leading Heath to offer to retrieve a copy of the old man's will.

events.action: Reports intruder tracks in her room
events.description: Ada enters to inform District Attorney Markham that someone was in her room, leaving muddy tracks across the carpet from the open balcony doors. Sergeant Heath notes these match outdoor footprints leading up to the balcony with no returning tracks down.

events.action: Reports bullet caliber findings and missing galoshes
events.description: Heath reveals that ballistic analysis confirms a .32-caliber bullet fired from the same handgun used in earlier shootings. He adds that the galoshes stored in the closet that match the outdoor tracks have disappeared.

events.action: Shows Vance the secret incense burner mailbox
events.description: Ada leads Vance to an incense burner in Rex's room, explaining that she and Rex used it as a private mailbox since childhood. She claims a note containing a medical reference about her mother was placed there but vanished before Rex was shot.

events.action: Discusses Mrs. Greene's medical diagnosis
events.description: On the roof garden, Vance asks Dr. Von Blon about Mrs. Greene's health, which the doctor describes as a simple paralysis of the legs. Sibella interrupts to remind Dr. Von Blon that he left his medical bag in her mother's room.

events.action: Muses about roof murder scenarios
events.description: Sibella remarks sarcastically that the roof garden would be an ideal place for a murder by pushing someone off into the river to look like an accident or suicide. She then asks Dr. Von Blon to head back downstairs.

events.action: Reports missing strychnine and morphine
events.description: Dr. Von Blon alerts Markham and Heath that four grains of strychnine and eight grains of morphine were taken from his medical bag while it was unattended in the mansion. Heath announces plans to place a police nurse inside the house and extra surveillance outside.

events.action: Reviews the stipulations of Tobias Greene's will
events.description: Vance and Markham examine the copy of old Tobias Greene's will provided by Heath. They note life annuities designated for servants Sproot and Mrs. Mannheim, as well as a clause bequeathing the family library to the police department after fifteen years.

events.action: Discusses potential motives tied to the estate
events.description: Vance and Markham discuss how the restrictions and financial provisions of the late Tobias Greene's will might provide a logical or psychological motive for the killer.

events.action: Discussing the Greene family inheritance and potential motives
events.description: Markham and Philo Vance discuss the motive behind the Greene family murders, noting that three family members remain. Vance suggests investigating Tobias Greene's library, asking why he would leave his collection of books to the police.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Markham, and a police officer
events.action: Asking for updates and examining the library door lock
events.description: Markham and Vance ask an officer for updates and learn that Sibella is out riding with Dr. Von Blonn. Vance inspects the library door lock, noting that the key turns easily and the hinges move smoothly despite claims that it had been locked for ten years.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Markham, and the police sergeant
events.action: Entering the dark library and discovering galoshes
events.description: The group enters the unlit library using flashlights and candles because the electric lights are nonfunctional. While searching the dark room, the police sergeant trips over a pair of galoshes on the floor.

events.actor: Philo Vance and the police sergeant
events.action: Inspecting Tobias Greene's book collection
events.description: Vance notices dust-free shelves and a chair indicating recent use by a frequent reader. They discover volumes on criminology, poisons, and sleepwalking, prompting speculation about whether Mrs. Greene could be faking her paralysis.

events.actor: A young woman, Markham, and Philo Vance
events.action: Reporting a sighting of Mrs. Greene walking
events.description: A frightened young woman enters the library to report hearing a shuffling noise on the stairs an hour prior. She claims she looked over the banister and saw Mrs. Greene walking in her oriental shawl near the library door.

events.actor: Philo Vance and the police sergeant
events.action: Discussing Ada's morphine poisoning and survival
events.description: Vance learns that Ada was poisoned with morphine but survived after prompt medical intervention. The sergeant explains that Dr. Von Blonn was summoned after the butler heard a bell ringing downstairs.

events.actor: Nurse O'Brien, Philo Vance, and Markham
events.action: Questioning Nurse O'Brien about delivering the bouillon
events.description: Nurse O'Brien explains that Mrs. Greene requested she bring a cup of bouillon to Ada. Nurse O'Brien notes that she placed the cup down while Ada was in the bathroom and asserts that Mrs. Greene did not touch it.

events.action: Analyzing how the cup was poisoned and how help was summoned
events.description: Vance hypothesizes that Mrs. Greene got out of bed to poison Ada's cup while Ada was in the bathroom. He explains that Sibella's dog played with a toy attached to a bell cord, inadvertently alerting the household in time to save Ada.

events.actor: Dr. Von Blonn, Philo Vance, and Markham
events.action: Interrogating Dr. Von Blonn regarding his alibi and diagnosis
events.description: Dr. Von Blonn claims he was away on a case in Greenwich, Connecticut during the night. Vance informs him that a police surgeon and specialist will be performing a formal examination on Mrs. Greene.

events.action: Placing a phone call to verify Dr. Von Blonn's alibi
events.description: After Dr. Von Blonn departs, Vance uses the telephone to request a connection to the county clerk in Greenwich, Connecticut. He seeks independent verification of Dr. Von Blonn's whereabouts.

events.action: Reporting the death of Mrs. Greene
events.description: Markham informs Vance that Mrs. Greene has died from strychnine, believing she committed suicide because police were closing in. Vance firmly disagrees, stating that suicide does not fit the psychological evidence.

events.action: Writing notes and requesting a medical examination of leg muscles
events.description: Vance writes down facts regarding Dr. Von Blonn's statements on Mrs. Greene's paralysis. He requests that medical examiners specifically check the condition of Mrs. Greene's leg muscles.

events.action: Answering the return call from Greenwich, Connecticut
events.description: Vance answers the telephone call from the county clerk in Greenwich, Connecticut. He takes down information regarding Dr. Von Blonn's claimed activities.

events.action: Delivering a document to Philo Vance
events.description: A detective enters the room and hands Vance a document or newspaper, complaining about working on a Saturday. Vance reviews the item as he continues analyzing the case.

events.actor: Medical Examiner, Philo Vance, District Attorney Markham
events.action: Medical examiner provides initial autopsy observations
events.description: The medical examiner tells Vance and Markham that he will prepare a formal report regarding Mrs. Greene's leg muscles and her physical capacity. Vance acknowledges the examiner's statement.

events.actor: Woman in domestic dress (Mrs. Mannheim), Philo Vance, Sergeant Heath
events.action: Woman recites scriptures hysterically in the study
events.description: The domestic worker recites passages from scripture regarding death and judgment. Sergeant Heath asks what she is doing, and she claims she is cleansing out corruption.

events.actor: Medical Examiner, Philo Vance, Sergeant Heath
events.action: Medical examiner confirms Mrs. Greene's permanent paralysis
events.description: The medical examiner states that Mrs. Greene's leg muscles had been completely wasted away for years, making walking or standing impossible. Heath points out that Ada previously claimed to have seen her mother walking at the door.

events.action: Vance notes the critical contradiction in the suspect's statement
events.description: Vance tells Markham and Heath that confirming Mrs. Greene could not walk puts him on the right track to solve the case. He leaves to put the remaining facts together.

events.action: Vance questions Ada about seeing her mother
events.description: Vance asks Ada to repeat her statement about seeing her mother walking in front of the library. Ada re-confirms her claim and notes the figure was wearing her mother's shawl.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Ada Greene, Mrs. Mannheim
events.action: Ada implicates Sibella regarding the shawl before leaving
events.description: When Vance asks who else wore her mother's shawl, Ada answers that Sibella wore it frequently. She then abruptly excuses herself from the table in distress.

events.action: Vance questions Mrs. Mannheim about her late husband
events.description: Vance asks Mrs. Mannheim where she was living when her husband died. She answers that they were in Trenton, New Jersey.

events.action: Vance inquires about German language knowledge in the household
events.description: Vance asks Sprooot if anyone in the Greene family speaks or reads German. Sprooot confirms that old Mr. Greene had all his children learn German during business trips to Germany.

events.action: Vance verifies the state of the balcony window
events.description: Vance asks Sprooot if the window leading to the balcony steps was open when Ada was shot. Sprooot confirms that the window was open and that he closed it himself.

events.action: Heath takes telephone instructions from Vance
events.description: Vance instructs Heath to phone a specific address and request records on a name while covering all extensions to prevent eavesdropping.

events.action: Vance confronts Mrs. Mannheim with Ada's true parentage
events.description: Vance states that Mrs. Mannheim is Ada's birth mother and that Mr. Greene adopted Ada after her father went to a state hospital for the criminally insane. Mrs. Mannheim tearfully admits this and explains her promise to keep it secret.

events.action: Vance presents criminal history texts as Exhibit A
events.description: Heath suggests the cook committed the crimes for money, but Vance presents books on criminal history and criminology. Vance explains that the murderer meticulously copied techniques from these specialized volumes.

events.action: Vance demonstrates the booby-trapped gun mechanism
events.description: In Rex's room, Vance opens a secret panel near the fireplace mantle to reveal a handgun attached to a string mechanism. He demonstrates how opening the door pulled the trigger to kill Rex automatically.

events.action: Vance formally accuses Ada Greene of the murders
events.description: Heath speculates that Sibella was the killer, but Vance corrects him and explicitly accuses Ada. Vance explains that Ada used the German criminology books and lured Rex with a non-existent note to carry out the murder plot.

events.action: Vance holds books while discussing Ada's motives with Heath.
events.description: Philo Vance explains to Sergeant Heath that Ada's motives stemmed from jealousy of Sibella, resentment over her household status, a desire for freedom, and inherited criminal traits. He shows the crime literature she studied in the library.

events.action: Vance details Ada's shooting method and staging.
events.description: Vance outlines how Ada took Chester's revolver and galoshes, sneaked around the house during the snowfall, shot Chester, and then shot herself in the back to create a false trail.

events.action: Vance explains how the gun was pulled out the window.
events.description: Vance explains that Ada rigged a weighted cord attached to the revolver through an open window, causing the gun to be pulled outside immediately after she shot herself.

events.action: Vance clarifies the poisonings and the alarm.
events.description: Vance explains that Ada poisoned Mrs. Greene and herself to divert suspicion, using the dog's teeth on the bell cord to sound the alarm.

events.action: Vance realizes Ada and Sibella are currently on the roof.
events.description: Heath mentions that Ada and Sibella are currently on the roof together, causing Vance to immediately react and call for urgency.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Sergeant Heath, Police Officers
events.action: Vance and Heath rush up the stairs toward the roof entrance.
events.description: Heath finds the roof door locked, but Vance warns everyone to remain quiet and enter through a window to avoid alerting Ada.

events.action: Ada leads Sibella onto the snowy roof terrace.
events.description: Ada guides Sibella out onto the snow-covered roof under the pretense of showing her the view of the river and boats.

events.action: Ada attacks Sibella on the edge of the roof.
events.description: Ada suddenly grabs Sibella and tries to force her over the roof parapet into the icy water, prompting screaming and a desperate struggle.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Ada Greene, Sibella Greene
events.action: Vance rescues Sibella while Ada falls from the roof.
events.description: Vance reaches the roof, pulls Sibella back to safety, and Ada slips from the snowy ledge, plummeting into the icy river below.

events.action: Police officers head outside to search for Ada.
events.description: Officers hurry down to the ground level and riverbank following Ada's fall into the river.

events.action: Vance comforts Sibella inside the house.
events.description: Inside the study, Vance stands near a seated Sibella, who expresses her deep gratitude to him for saving her life.

events.actor: Philo Vance, Sergeant Heath, Sibella Greene
events.action: Heath enters to report Ada's demise, and Vance congratulates Sibella.
events.description: Heath reports that Ada went straight through the ice with no chance of rescue. Vance informs Sibella that he verified her secret marriage to Dr. Von Blon in Greenwich and wishes her happiness.

events.action: Heath asks a final question about the gun and snow.
events.description: As they walk out, Heath asks how the gun disappeared without open water, and Vance points out that snow served the purpose. Heath remarks that life is just a problem, and Vance agrees.

events.action: The Paramount end title card is displayed.
events.description: The film concludes with the Paramount title card overlay reading 'A Paramount Picture / The End' as the musical score finishes.
